# socat -- Socket relay tool

## Candy Properties

| Property | Value |
|----------|-------|
| Install files | `charly.yml`, `task:` |

## Packages

RPM: `socat`, `iproute`

## Cross-distro coverage

`rpm:` (Fedora), `pac:` (Arch), `deb:` (Debian/Ubuntu — `socat`, `iproute2`). Full parity.

## Usage

```yaml
# charly.yml
my-image:
  candy:
    - socat
```

Typically not added directly. Auto-included when a candy uses `port_relay:` in its `charly.yml`.

**Note:** Chrome no longer uses socat for its DevTools port relay. Chrome now uses a `cdp-proxy` Python supervisord service (see [`/charly-selkies:chrome`](/recipes/selkies/chrome/)). Socat is still used by other `port_relay` consumers.

## When to Use This Skill

Use when the user asks about:

- Port relay setup (eth0 to loopback)
- socat configuration
- Exposing loopback-only services
- The `socat` candy or `port_relay` field
